items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: There was two brothers. Baron and Leroy... And Leroy never allowed any white people.

ctx.x: It was all white. And it was a funny thing. There was two brothers. Baron and Leroy. Baron Wilkins never had never allowed any of the colored people to come into his place. And Leroy never allowed any white people. But Leroy, -- one white man used to come into his place.
